description: Oil and gas extraction income-statement skeleton for SIC 1311 retaining all 128 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied ConocoPhillips reference guides presentation. Consolidated earnings, producing-activity disclosures, capitalized costs, OCI, distributions and denominator alternatives remain distinct. Hierarchy defines no arithmetic.
classification_notes: All 128 supplied unique concepts appear once. The industry inventory is not a claim that ConocoPhillips reports every concept or uses every presentation.

The reference presentation guides ordering and families only. Its unusual-items, interest-capitalized and EBITDA presentations do not establish taxonomy equivalence, signs, nonrecurrence or a calculated subtotal. No EBITDA, EBITDAX or cash-flow proxy is manufactured.
Functional production/exploration/administrative expenses overlap natural DD&A, taxes, personnel, leases and share-based expenses. Choose the issuer aggregate or reconciled components.
OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A and production-related costs classified in cost of sales. Nonproduction DepreciationAndAmortization is distinct from producing DD&A and depletion.
AccretionExpense excludes ARO. ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairmentExpense specifically measures impairment of unproved properties, including unsuccessful/doubtful capitalized exploratory wells.

ResultsOfOperations measures concern producing activities. Revenue excludes royalties and net profit disbursements; activity expense and pretax result exclude general corporate overhead and interest costs. These are supplementary rather than interchangeable with consolidated IS totals.
Producing lifting costs include specified taxes and support depreciation. DD&A with valuation provisions differs from DD&A with accretion and can overlap activity impairment and ARO accretion.
ProductionCosts is capitalized production cost. Acquisition/exploration/development incurred costs include both capitalized and expensed amounts. Neither is automatically an IS expense.
Net income, continuing/discontinued results and common numerators preserve consolidated/parent/NCI scope. Participating-security allocations are separate from preferred dividends.
Discontinued EPS includes activity-plus-disposal versus activity-only alternatives. Pro forma and issued-share denominators are supplementary, not reported basic/diluted outstanding denominators.

RestructuringCosts is after cash payments under its definition, unlike gross RestructuringCharges. Contingent consideration liability changes can include settlement/non-earnings effects; both require reconciliation.
The financial-service sale-gain tag remains scope-specific. Currency OCI and stock dividends are not earnings or cash expense. All fact signs and dimensions require source context.

metadata_contract.period_type: All 128 supplied concepts verified as duration in official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: 115 monetary, 9 per-share and 4 shares concepts verified from the official schema; source facts determine currency/scale.
metadata_contract.contra: False throughout for expense/result/allocation/share/distribution measures; no automatic expense negation or gains reversal is implied.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 128 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 1311.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Revenue presentation
nodes.classification_note: All revenue can contain customer-contract, noncontract, operating interest and lease income. Tax-inclusive/exclusive customer revenue is alternative measurement, not additive.

children.label: Reported revenue totals
children.classification_note: Use the issuer reported total rather than manufacturing a sum across overlapping revenue categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Revenues
concepts.review_reason: Reported all-revenue totals may include customer-contract and other revenue populations; do not add those separately reported revenue views to the total.

children.label: Customer-contract revenue alternatives
children.classification_note: Including/excluding assessed taxes are alternative measurement bases for overlapping customer-contract revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract revenue excludes assessed taxes and can be included in all revenue; it differs from the tax-inclusive alternative and noncontract revenue.

children.label: Revenue from contract with customer including assessed tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract revenue including assessed taxes is an alternative tax basis to the excluding-tax amount; do not sum both.

children.label: Noncontract and operating interest revenue
children.classification_note: Lease income can be part of noncustomer-contract revenue; operating interest can already be included in revenue.

children.label: Revenue not from contract with customer

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer
concepts.review_reason: Noncustomer-contract revenue differs in accounting scope from customer-contract revenue and can include lease income supplied separately; establish coverage before combining.

children.label: Operating lease income including variable payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease income includes specified variable payments and can be included in noncontract or total revenue; it is lessor income rather than lessee lease cost.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating
concepts.review_reason: Operating interest income is distinct from explicitly nonoperating net interest; establish whether it is included in reported revenue.

nodes.label: Operating costs and expenses
nodes.classification_note: Functional, natural and asset-class expenses overlap. No sum of these presentation families is prescribed; producing-activity supplementary measures are kept separately.

children.label: Reported cost total alternatives
children.classification_note: CostsAndExpenses may include nonoperating costs. OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A and production-related cost of sales, unlike other supplied operating/cost aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: CostsAndExpenses can span operating and nonoperating costs and overlap operating totals, cost of revenue and interest; identify the scope used in the issuer statement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingExpenses may contain functional costs and SG&A, whereas OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A and costs assigned to production cost of sales; reconcile the issuer total coverage.

children.label: Operating costs excluding SG&A and cost of sales

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A and production-related costs included in cost of sales; it is not equivalent to all operating expenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfRevenue
concepts.review_reason: CostOfRevenue can contain the goods/services cost of sales and broader revenue-generating costs; do not add overlapping cost aggregates.

children.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold
concepts.review_reason: Goods/services cost of sales excludes financial-service revenue costs and may differ from the broader CostOfRevenue population; reconcile DD&A inclusion.

children.label: Exploration and unproved-property costs
children.classification_note: Exploration can include support depreciation and dry-hole costs. Unproved-property impairment can overlap exploration and broader property impairment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExplorationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Exploration expense can include dry holes, support-equipment depreciation, undeveloped-property carrying costs and prospecting; it may overlap unproved-property impairment and functional cost totals.

children.label: Unproved-property impairment and exploratory well write-offs

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: Despite its name, this is impairment of unproved oil/gas properties, including capitalized exploratory wells with unsuccessful or doubtful projects; it can overlap oil/gas impairment and exploration expense.

children.label: Depreciation, depletion and amortization
children.classification_note: All DD&A, nonproduction D&A, depreciation-only, depletion-only and residual D&A are overlapping measures; production allocation can already include these charges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: DD&A can include depreciation and oil/gas depletion supplied separately; it differs from nonproduction DepreciationAndAmortization and producing-only supplementary measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: The official definition concerns nonproduction physical/intangible asset consumption; it is not interchangeable with oil/gas producing DD&A or depletion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Depreciation
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation is a component of broader DD&A and may include support equipment costs already allocated to exploration or production expense.

children.label: Depletion of oil and gas properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepletionOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas depletion can be included in total DD&A or producing-activity DD&A and must not be added again to those aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Other D&A is a residual within broader depreciation/amortization or DD&A totals; establish the excluded asset classes.

children.label: Accretion by liability scope
children.classification_note: ARO accretion and AccretionExpense excluding ARO are explicitly different scopes. Neither is an investing acquisition cost or cash settlement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: ARO accretion reflects passage of time on discounted retirement liabilities and differs from AccretionExpense, which explicitly excludes ARO; producing-activity ARO accretion is a separate scope disclosure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: AccretionExpense explicitly excludes asset retirement obligation accretion; do not map it to the oil/gas ARO accretion measure or assume identical presentation.

children.label: Asset impairment scopes
children.classification_note: All-asset, long-lived-held-for-use and oil/gas property impairments overlap and may contain unproved-property write-offs; net disposal/impairment aggregates are separate alternatives.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Total asset impairment can contain oil/gas, unproved exploratory and other long-lived asset impairments; do not add detailed impairments to this total.

children.label: Impairment of long-lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-use long-lived impairment can include oil/gas impairment and assets to be disposed of other than by sale; reconcile it against asset-class and broad impairment totals.

children.label: Impairment of oil and gas properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas property impairment can be included in broad asset or held-for-use impairment and can contain unproved exploratory write-offs; select a reconciled property population.

children.label: General and administrative costs
children.classification_note: SG&A can contain G&A and residual G&A; management/professional fees may already be included. Do not add aggregate and component views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: SG&A includes G&A and can include management, personnel, professional and allocated share-based expenses supplied separately; use a reconciled functional presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: G&A can be included in SG&A and may contain personnel, management and professional fees reported separately; identify residual versus aggregate presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other G&A is a residual within total G&A or SG&A and may contain professional/management fees also reported separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ManagementFeeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Management fees may already be included in G&A or producing-activity expenses and can overlap other professional-service costs; determine functional scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfessionalFees
concepts.review_reason: Professional fees can be included in G&A/SG&A, acquisition costs or other expense; identify functional allocation before aggregation.

children.label: Personnel and share-based expenses
children.classification_note: Natural personnel and allocated share-award expenses can be distributed among exploration, production and G&A; they are not additional functional totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LaborAndRelatedExpense
concepts.review_reason: Personnel costs can be allocated to production, exploration and G&A and may include allocated share-based compensation; do not add natural and functional cost views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Allocated share-based compensation is a natural expense that may already be included in G&A, personnel and other functional costs; it is not an additional cost to add by default.

children.label: Lessee operating lease costs
children.classification_note: Single operating lease cost and lease expense excluding sublease income overlap and may already be included in functional costs; lessor revenue is separate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseCost
concepts.review_reason: OperatingLeaseCost is the single lessee operating lease cost and can overlap operating lease expense and functional production/G&A costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease expense excludes sublease income under its definition and may overlap operating lease cost; neither should be added to functional costs already containing lease charges.

children.label: Production and other taxes
children.classification_note: Production tax may be included in lifting costs and broader other-than-income taxes. Tax subsets and residuals must be reconciled; these are not income taxes by default.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProductionTaxExpense
concepts.review_reason: Production tax on oil/gas can be included in lifting costs and broader taxes excluding income/excise; do not add a tax subset to its expense aggregate.

children.label: Taxes excluding income and excise taxes

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Taxes excluding income and excise can include production and severance taxes supplied separately; it differs from all other tax expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesOther
concepts.review_reason: Other tax expense has unspecified tax population and can overlap production or other-than-income tax charges; do not equate it with income tax expense.

children.label: R&D, credit provision and residual operating costs
children.classification_note: R&D differs from exploration; credit expense and residual costs may already be included in functional totals. No missing production-expense subtotal is manufactured.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: R&D expense may be included in broader operating expense or SG&A presentation; distinguish it from exploration expense and capitalized property development.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Doubtful-account provision may already be included in other operating or administrative expense; it is an expense, not the balance-sheet receivable allowance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherCostAndExpenseOperating
concepts.review_reason: Other operating costs are a residual that can contain separately reported exploration, accretion or taxes; determine issuer exclusions.

nodes.label: Operating result measures
nodes.classification_note: Reported gross profit and operating income are distinct result levels. Net other operating results overlap income-only and residual expense views; no automatic equation is defined.

children.label: Other operating income or expense, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: Net other operating income/expense can contain other operating income and residual operating expense; choose a consistent net or gross presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other operating income is income-only and can be included in net other operating income/expense; do not add both.

nodes.label: Financing and nonoperating results
nodes.classification_note: Interest, equity-method, investment and residual results may be included in reported nonoperating totals. Select issuer presentation and avoid duplicate gross/net interest deductions.

children.label: Nonoperating total and residual alternatives
children.classification_note: Total nonoperating results and residual other results overlap; income-only and expense-only measures are components or alternatives depending on issuer coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: The nonoperating aggregate can include interest, equity-method and other results separately mapped; confirm issuer inclusions before using details alongside it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Residual nonoperating income/expense may already contain the other-income-only or other-expense-only measures; preserve the issuer exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating income is an income-only view and can already be netted into other nonoperating income/expense or total nonoperating results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating expense is expense-only and can already be netted in residual or total nonoperating income/expense.

children.label: Interest expense views
children.classification_note: All interest, explicitly nonoperating interest, interest/debt financing costs and debt/other components overlap. Determine capitalization and expense coverage from issuer facts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: InterestExpense can overlap nonoperating interest, debt interest and combined interest/debt expense; match capitalized versus expensed coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest expense can be contained in InterestAndDebtExpense and the issuer broader interest expense; do not deduct it again after selecting a net nonoperating-interest measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense
concepts.review_reason: Interest and debt expense covers nonoperating financing-related costs and can contain standalone interest expense/debt interest; reconcile capitalized versus expensed interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt
concepts.review_reason: Debt interest is an instrument-specific component that can be included in broader interest and nonoperating interest/debt expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest expense is a residual within broader interest expense and can overlap debt/lease financing charges; determine issuer exclusions.

children.label: Net interest alternatives
children.classification_note: Generic net interest has unresolved operating scope while the other tag explicitly covers nonoperating income/expense; neither is additional to matching gross interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatingNet
concepts.review_reason: Net nonoperating interest income/expense is an alternative to matching gross nonoperating interest income and expense; do not deduct the expense component again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: Generic net interest income/expense does not establish operating versus nonoperating location; it can overlap gross interest and the explicitly nonoperating net measure.

children.label: Interest income views
children.classification_note: Interest-and-other income can contain investment and other interest; do not add combined and component measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndOtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: Interest and other income combines interest with other earnings and can overlap standalone investment/other interest and residual income measures.

children.label: Nonoperating securities interest before premium adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest
concepts.review_reason: Investment interest can be included in interest-and-other-income or other interest income; it is not automatically an additional nonoperating receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest income can be part of investment interest or interest-and-other-income; identify residual portfolio coverage and operating/nonoperating location.

children.label: Equity-method and investment results
children.classification_note: Equity-method income may sit before/after the selected pretax subtotal depending on its definition. Broad investment gains can overlap event or asset-class results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method earnings may be included before or after the selected pretax subtotal depending on that subtotal scope; avoid counting them twice.

children.label: Realized and unrealized investment gains and losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment gains can include asset classes or realization scopes also reported in derivative/property results; establish portfolio coverage rather than treating all gains as additional.

nodes.label: Disposal, remeasurement and event results
nodes.classification_note: This event grouping does not assert nonrecurrence or a universal operating/nonoperating location. Earnings results differ from cash proceeds and can be included in functional/result totals.

children.label: Property and business disposal results
children.classification_note: Broad asset gains can contain PP&E, oil/gas property and business-sale results. Combined disposal-and-impairment results overlap both gains and impairment charges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1
concepts.review_reason: Broad asset disposal gains can include PP&E, intangibles and subsidiary/equity-method interests; they overlap narrower property and business-sale results.

children.label: PP&E sale gain or loss including oil, gas and timber

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E disposal gains include oil/gas and timber property under the definition and can contain the separately supplied oil/gas sale result.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of oil and gas property

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasProperty
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas property sale gains are a narrower asset population than PP&E or broad disposal gains and may already be included in those aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: Business-sale gains can be included in broad asset disposal or nonoperating results and do not represent cash sale proceeds.

children.label: Combined asset sale and impairment result

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Combined asset-sale and impairment results overlap the separately supplied disposal gains and impairment charges; choose the net aggregate or matching components.

children.label: Derivative and hedging results
children.classification_note: Fair-value changes recognized in earnings, broad pretax derivatives, non-designated positions, oil/gas hedges and unrealized commodities overlap. Do not reverse OCI into IS by assumption.

children.label: Derivative fair-value change recognized in earnings

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: This derivative measure is fair-value changes recognized in the income statement; it can overlap broader pretax derivative results and is not equivalent to all hedge settlements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: Pretax derivative gains can contain designated and non-designated positions and overlap income-statement fair-value changes; identify recognized earnings versus OCI.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: Non-designated derivative gains are a subset of overall derivative earnings; designated oil/gas hedges and unrealized commodity views may have different coverage.

children.label: Gain loss on oil and gas hedging activity

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnOilAndGasHedgingActivity
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas hedging gains can include designated hedge results also contained in overall derivative earnings; distinguish them from unrealized-only and non-designated derivative measures.

children.label: Unrealized gain loss on commodity contracts

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnCommodityContracts
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized commodity contract gains are a valuation subset that can be contained in total derivative earnings; determine earnings recognition and hedge designation.

children.label: Financing and currency event results
children.classification_note: Debt extinguishment, warrant liability fair-value and foreign-currency transaction earnings can be included in nonoperating totals. Currency translation OCI remains supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants
concepts.review_reason: Warrant fair-value adjustment is expense/income on warrant liabilities and may overlap other financial remeasurement results; it is not a commodity hedge gain.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: Foreign-currency transaction gains differ from translation OCI and may overlap other income/expense; keep the earnings and OCI populations distinct.

children.label: Acquisition, restructuring and legal costs
children.classification_note: Transaction, restructuring, contractual severance and litigation charges can be included in G&A/personnel expenses. The post-cash-payment restructuring measure is supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition-related costs can already be included in G&A or restructuring/transaction presentations; their occurrence does not establish that they are nonrecurring.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestructuringCharges
concepts.review_reason: Restructuring charges exclude discontinued operations and ARO; they may include severance and other functional costs and are not equivalent to the after-cash-payment restructuring-cost measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1
concepts.review_reason: SeveranceCosts1 concerns special or contractual termination benefits and excludes one-time termination benefits; it may be contained in restructuring or personnel expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LitigationSettlementExpense
concepts.review_reason: Litigation settlement expense can be included in G&A or other costs and can contain accruals; it is not by definition an unusual or nonrecurring amount.

nodes.label: Pretax income and income taxes
nodes.classification_note: Pretax subtotal definitions differ in whether equity-method results are included. Current federal tax is contained in current tax, which is contained in all income-tax expense.

children.label: Pretax result alternatives
children.classification_note: Before-equity-method and including-equity-method pretax measures are alternatives at different result levels; both preserve NCI scope under their definitions.

children.label: Pretax continuing income before equity method results
Income-tax total and components
children.classification_note: Income tax expense is the total measure; current and federal-current amounts are narrower components, not extra full tax charges.

children.label: Continuing-operation income tax expense or benefit
Current income tax expense or benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Current income tax is a component of total income tax expense, not an alternative total; it can include the federal-only current tax supplied separately.

children.label: Current federal or national tax expense or benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:CurrentFederalTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Current federal tax is a jurisdictional subset of current tax expense and total tax expense; it is not an additional full income-tax charge.

nodes.label: Continuing and discontinued results
nodes.classification_note: Parent-attributable continuing income differs from continuing income including NCI. Discontinued net-of-tax income preserves its own consolidated/attribution scope.

nodes.label: Net income and attribution
nodes.classification_note: ProfitLoss includes consolidated ownership interests; NetIncomeLoss is parent-attributable. Total NCI may contain redeemable NCI. Do not subtract NCI from an already parent-attributable result.

children.label: Net income attributable to redeemable NCI

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedeemableNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable NCI income is an attribution subset that can already be included in total NCI results; redemption classification does not create an extra earnings deduction.

nodes.label: Common income and allocations
nodes.classification_note: Basic/diluted common numerators, preferred dividends and participating-security allocations preserve different roles; preferred and participation adjustments are not interchangeable.

children.label: Common income numerator alternatives
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted common earnings can differ due to numerator adjustments and are not additive.

children.label: Preferred dividend adjustments
children.classification_note: Preferred dividends and other adjustments is broader than the dividend-only IS impact; stock-settled dividends are a supplementary declaration disclosure.

children.label: Preferred dividends and other common-income adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Preferred dividends and other adjustments is broader than preferred dividends alone and can contain the separately supplied preferred dividend impact.

children.label: Participating-security allocations
children.classification_note: Basic/diluted allocations concern participating securities rather than preferred dividends and may already be reflected in common earnings.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
concepts.review_reason: Basic participating-security allocations reduce the common earnings allocation and are distinct from preferred dividends; preserve the basic-versus-diluted numerator scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesDiluted
concepts.review_reason: Diluted participating-security allocations have a diluted common-earnings numerator scope and are not interchangeable with basic allocations or preferred dividends.

nodes.label: Earnings per share
nodes.classification_note: Total, continuing and discontinued EPS are different numerators and can have different denominator rules; do not construct total EPS by adding mismatched reported components.

children.label: Total EPS
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted EPS are alternatives with different denominators.

children.label: Continuing-operation EPS
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted continuing EPS preserve parent attribution and denominator scope.

children.label: Discontinued EPS including disposal
children.classification_note: These definitions include discontinued operating activity and disposal gains/losses; they are broader than activity-only discontinued EPS.

children.label: Basic discontinued-operation EPS including disposal result
Diluted discontinued-operation EPS including disposal result
Discontinued activity-only EPS
children.classification_note: These definitions concern discontinued activity without the broader activity-plus-disposal scope; do not equate with similarly named discontinued EPS.

nodes.label: Weighted-average outstanding shares
nodes.classification_note: Reported basic/diluted outstanding denominators differ from issued shares before treasury deductions and pro forma transaction-based denominators retained in supplements.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Producing-activity measures, capitalized/incurred costs, OCI, distributions, pro forma denominators and unresolved expense candidates remain separate from consolidated IS arithmetic.

children.label: Oil/gas producing-activity results
children.classification_note: Activity disclosures have defined oil/gas scopes and do not form a duplicate consolidated IS. Activity expenses/results exclude general corporate overhead and interest; transportation, G&A, DD&A, taxes and impairment can overlap narrower activity costs.

children.label: Producing revenue, expenses and result
children.classification_note: Revenue excludes royalty and net-profit disbursements. Reported activity expenses/results have a different overhead/interest scope than consolidated totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsRevenueFromOilAndGasProducingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity revenue excludes royalty payments and net profit disbursements under its definition; its supplementary activity scope need not equal consolidated revenues.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOilAndGasProducingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity expenses exclude general corporate overhead and interest costs; they are not total consolidated costs and contain narrower production/exploration/DD&A views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsIncomeBeforeIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity pretax results exclude general corporate overhead and interest costs; they are not the consolidated continuing-operation pretax subtotal.

children.label: Producing-activity operating cost details
children.classification_note: Lifting costs can include taxes and support depreciation; transportation, exploration and activity G&A can be part of broader activity expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsProductionOrLiftingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Supplementary lifting costs include support depreciation, property and severance taxes and operating inputs; they can overlap consolidated DD&A, production taxes and functional expenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsTransportationCosts
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity transportation costs are supplementary expenses that can already be in consolidated production or cost-of-sales measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsExplorationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity exploration expense includes geological/geophysical and dry-hole costs and may be contained in the consolidated exploration expense and activity expense total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsGeneralAndAdministrativeRelatedToOilAndGasProducingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity G&A is an activity-specific allocation and can overlap consolidated G&A; the producing-activity result excludes general corporate overhead.

children.label: Producing-activity asset charge alternatives
children.classification_note: DD&A/valuation provisions and DD&A/accretion differ in scope and overlap impairment and ARO-accretion components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationAndValuationProvisions
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity DD&A plus valuation provisions combines consumption and valuation charges; it overlaps standalone producing impairment and the DD&A/accretion alternative.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletionAmortizationAndAccretion
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity DD&A/accretion includes accretion and differs from DD&A plus valuation provisions; component coverage can overlap ARO accretion and impairments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity impairment is a supplementary activity-specific charge and can already be included in producing DD&A/valuation provisions or consolidated oil/gas impairment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsAccretionOfAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity ARO accretion is supplementary activity-specific expense and can overlap consolidated ARO accretion or producing DD&A/accretion.

children.label: Capitalized and incurred activity costs
children.classification_note: Property acquisition/exploration/development costs combine capitalized and expensed amounts, while ProductionCosts is capitalized production cost; neither is a universal IS expense subtotal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsIncurredOilAndGasPropertyAcquisitionExplorationAndDevelopmentActivities
concepts.review_reason: Costs incurred for acquisition, exploration and development include both capitalized costs and expensed costs; this investment activity disclosure is not an IS expense subtotal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProductionCosts
concepts.review_reason: ProductionCosts is capitalized production cost incurred under the official definition, not a reported consolidated production expense; retain it as an activity cost disclosure.

children.label: Geographic and financial-service scope disclosures
children.classification_note: Domestic pretax income is a geographic component. The financial-service asset-sale gain definition does not establish an oil/gas disposal mapping.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic
concepts.review_reason: Domestic continuing-operation pretax income is a geographic subset of the relevant consolidated pretax result and is not an extra pretax subtotal.

children.label: Financial-service asset disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: The definition restricts this sale-gain tag to assets used in financial-service operations; it cannot be substituted for generic oil/gas or PP&E disposal gains.

children.label: Distributions and OCI
children.classification_note: Cash dividends per share and stock-settled preferred dividends are distributions, not expenses. Before-tax currency OCI differs from foreign-currency transaction earnings.

children.label: Common stock dividends per share cash paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid
concepts.review_reason: Cash dividends paid per common share are distributions, not earnings per share or an income-statement expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DividendsPreferredStockStock
concepts.review_reason: Preferred dividends settled in stock include paid and unpaid declared amounts; they are not cash payments or necessarily the same as the preferred dividend IS impact.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurrencyTransactionAndTranslationAdjustmentBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: Foreign-currency transaction/translation adjustment is before tax and after reclassification in OCI; it is not the foreign-currency transaction earnings result.

children.label: Alternative share denominators
children.classification_note: Issued shares before treasury reductions and pro forma diluted shares do not replace reported outstanding EPS denominators.

concepts.name: us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesIssuedBasic
concepts.review_reason: Weighted-average shares issued are before treasury-share reductions and differ from weighted-average outstanding shares used for basic EPS.

children.label: Pro forma diluted weighted average shares

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProFormaWeightedAverageSharesOutstandingDiluted
concepts.review_reason: Pro forma diluted weighted-average shares reflect a hypothetical transaction basis and are not the reported diluted EPS denominator.

children.label: Reconciliation and expense candidates requiring review
children.classification_note: Broad residuals, contingent consideration liability changes and after-cash restructuring amounts require issuer location and earnings reconciliation before primary IS use.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: OtherIncome has unresolved operating/nonoperating coverage and can overlap more specifically classified residual income; do not infer location solely from the tag.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OtherExpenses has unresolved functional and operating/nonoperating coverage; preserve the candidate outside primary expense totals until issuer presentation is established.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherGeneralExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other general expense has unresolved functional scope and may be contained in G&A or other operating costs; identify issuer placement before primary aggregation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability1
concepts.review_reason: Contingent consideration liability changes can include settlement differences and remeasurement outside earnings; they are not a pure IS expense without issuer reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestructuringCosts
concepts.review_reason: The official definition measures restructuring expense after cash payments and excludes discontinued operations and ARO; retain as a reconciliation disclosure rather than a second gross restructuring charge.
